text: It has been an honor to serve San Marcos as your Councilmember for the last 8 years. San Marcos is where I grew up, was educated, and where I acquired my work ethic and passion for serving others. In my 45 years in San Marcos, I have experienced both opportunities and inequities. These experiences ground my leadership as an attorney, community advocate, and as your Councilmember.

As your representative, I have invested in critical infrastructure, expanded access to economic opportunity for businesses and local families, strengthened public safety, and championed housing accessibility. I have supported policies that encourage civic participation, advance equity, promote sustainable economic development, and expand pathways to quality jobs.

Too many working families continue to face rising economic pressures, including the challenges of affordable housing and food insecurity. More than ever, I am committed to improving the lives of all San Marcos community members, supporting local businesses, and creating the conditions for our entire community to thrive.

There’s still more we can accomplish together. I look forward to working with you in building a stronger, more inclusive, and more prosperous San Marcos. I am committed to continue serving you to ensure everyone enjoys a thriving quality of life.

statement.disclaimer: The statements are the opinions of the authors and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
